agents.notes: Every field the contract allows, in one row. Most agents need far less. Verified by hand against 3.0.2. The file says schema 2 because it uses envPassthrough. EVEREST_API_KEY is read from the login shell at each launch and stored nowhere. Both resume defaults are turned off here on evidence. The lookup is global, and `--conversation` with no value exits 2 rather than attaching to something else. Settings, not this file, holds your hotkey, flag preset, paste and newline choices.
